baseline.name: Lymph circuit v2 (~6 min)
baseline.detail: In order: 10 deep belly breaths → neck rolls + shrugs x5/way → arm circles x20/way → overhead reach-to-knee x15 → torso twists x30 → heel bounces 60s → clap-under knee lifts x20 → ankle pumps x20. Central first, limbs after

baseline.name: 100 V-sits
baseline.detail: Break into sets as needed — all 100 count

baseline.name: Knee care (3 min)
baseline.detail: Band terminal knee extensions x15/side + wall sit 2×30s — pain-free, every single day. Daily dosing is what rebuilds the knee

baseline.name: Plank 60s
baseline.detail: One minute total (2×30s fine) — balances the v-sits and braces your spine for heavy bench/rows/squats

baseline.name: Protein target
baseline.detail: ~1g per lb of bodyweight today — the lifts only build what the protein pays for
